Japan's Nikkei 225 surged 4.62% on Tuesday, November 24, climbing to 59,045.30 as global markets rallied following Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. The broader Topix index also gained 2.8%, recovering from Friday's losses.
Meanwhile, Nvidia shares skyrocketed 31.5% on Wall Street on Monday, marking their biggest single-day percentage gain in 23 years and restoring nearly $1 trillion in market value.
